notes.title: We are released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34329928/cafa11a5a2e3b034d180c46b0e44b63b8b499fc8.jpg[/img]
We thank everyone who supported us in the early access phase and bought the game.
Thank you for believing in our game!
We thank you for your feedback and advice.


We fixed a lot
- added right-click (return item to inventory)
- added a lot of sounds and music
- English is better in the game

tags.feature: - added a lot of sounds and music

tags.bug: - English is better in the game
